dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, you sell at a stall and online. Which is better for your business?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈsɛl ət ə ˈstɔːl ənd ˌɑːnˈlaɪn. ˈwɪtʃ ɪz ˈbɛtər fər jʊr ˈbɪznəs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They both have advantages. The advantage of selling at a stall is that customers can see the food.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈboʊθ ˈhæv ədˈvæntɪdʒɪz. ði ədˈvæntɪdʒ əv ˈsɛlɪŋ ət ə ˈstɔːl ɪz ðæt ˈkʌstəmərz kən ˈsiː ðə ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The disadvantage of having a stall is the rent. Our running costs are quite high.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˌdɪsədˈvæntɪdʒ əv ˈhævɪŋ ə ˈstɔːl ɪz ðə ˈrɛnt. aʊər ˈrʌnɪŋ ˌkɔːsts ər ˈkwaɪt ˈhaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The advantage of selling online is that more people can find us. And we don't need a big space.
dialogue.reading: ði ədˈvæntɪdʒ əv ˈsɛlɪŋ ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ɪz ðæt ˈmɔːr ˈpiːpəl kən ˈfaɪnd ʌs. ənd wiː ˈdoʊnt ˈniːd ə ˈbɪɡ ˈspeɪs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not very. Delivery is expensive, so we earn less on each box.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri. dɪˈlɪvəri ɪz ɪkˈspɛnsɪv, soʊ wiː ˈɜːrn ˈlɛs ɑːn ˈiːtʃ ˈbɑːks.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So what's the biggest risk for your business?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈwʌts ðə ˈbɪɡɪst ˈrɪsk fər jʊr ˈbɪznəs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Food prices. If vegetables get more expensive, our costs will rise.
dialogue.reading: ˈfuːd ˈpraɪsɪz. ɪf ˈvɛdʒtəbəlz ˈɡɛt ˈmɔːr ɪkˈspɛnsɪv, aʊər ˈkɔːsts wɪl ˈraɪz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's a real risk. How will you deal with it?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈriːəl ˈrɪsk. ˈhaʊ wɪl juː ˈdiːl wɪð ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We're thinking of buying directly from farmers. The advantage of doing that is cheaper and fresher vegetables.
dialogue.reading: wɪr ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əv ˈbaɪɪŋ dəˈrɛktli frəm ˈfɑːrmərz. ði ədˈvæntɪdʒ əv ˈduːɪŋ ˈðæt ɪz ˈtʃiːpər ənd ˈfrɛʃər ˈvɛdʒtəbəlz.
